name: tag
summary: Presents compact metadata, counts, and application links, with an optional real removal link for static filters.

agent.useWhen: Compact metadata, filter values, or categories belong beside primary content; use a count only when it has an accessible label, and use a link only for navigation.
agent.avoidWhen: The label communicates operational status, needs a sentence of explanation, or needs a command, form control, transient dismissal, or browser-local interaction.

invariants: Configuration selects tone, size, optional closed-catalog decorative icon, and static destination; visible label, count, and accessible count label are app-owned data.
A visible nonblank label is always present; tone never carries meaning by color alone.

A tag is static by default. href makes the tag a real navigation anchor; removeHref plus removeLabel adds a real, explicitly named navigation link only to an otherwise static tag. A linked tag cannot contain a second link.
count and countLabel are supplied together; the count's accessible name describes what is counted.

All text and href attributes are escaped. Destinations may be app-relative or HTTP(S); unsafe schemes, protocol-relative destinations, controls, whitespace-padded values, and backslashes are rejected.

Icons are decorative and must exist in the package's closed icons.json catalog. The removal affordance uses the catalog close icon and remains a real link; it does not run a command or dismiss client-side.
The package has no template expressions or scripts. The fragment has exactly one [[tag]] slot; the typed renderer substitutes once, so slot-shaped user text is not interpreted as template syntax.
There is no browser-local state, lifecycle, event output, command, or announcement behavior. The app owns domain state and decides when to rerender the static fragment.
